ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring and local compliance platform designed to track municipal waste dumping and industrial land violations in Indore using high-resolution geospatial imagery and automated change detection.
ideas.title: Indore-WasteNet: AI-Powered Municipal Landfill and Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy computer vision and environmental monitoring, directly mimicking the technical depth and local impact that won the GeoNex-ATLAS project at Xcelerate Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven nutritional tracking and regional meal planning platform tailored specifically for Indian dietary staples, providing real-time macro insights and affordable lifestyle guidance for rural and semi-urban communities.
ideas.title: Arogya-AI: Localized Nutritional & Maternal Wellness Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the proven, high-utility health-tech angle of the E-Foodiee project while targeting regional demographics highly relevant to an SGSITS-hosted national hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered graph intelligence platform that detects fraudulent transactions and financial anomalies in agricultural supply chain financing, combining graph neural networks with explainable risk scoring.
ideas.title: AgroGraph: Supply Chain Risk & AML Compliance for Local Co-operatives
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the complex graph intelligence and financial risk modeling architecture that secured 1st place for Bito in the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent AI platform built using LangGraph and RAG to track, gamify, and optimize energy consumption and waste reduction initiatives across a university campus.
ideas.title: CampusGreen: Multi-Agent Student Sustainability Support Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the winning multi-agent framework architecture from the greennovation-ai-platform to a relatable institutional use case that judges can instantly test on campus.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace featuring automated escrow payments and milestone verification via smart contracts designed for local freelance micro-tasks.
ideas.title: MicroEscrow: Autonomous Gig-Worker Payment & Dispute Resolution Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the autonomous escrow transaction mechanics that proved successful for the Dispatch project at the Synthesis Hackathon.
